package student

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

type ApplyStudentOnboardingTurn struct {
	Turns          repository.StudentOnboardingTurnRepository
	Clock          OnboardingClock
	EffectsEnabled bool
}

func (useCase ApplyStudentOnboardingTurn) Handle(
	ctx context.Context,
	input domain.StudentOnboardingTurnCommand,
) (domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult, error) {
	if useCase.Turns == nil || useCase.Clock == nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	input.OccurredAt = useCase.Clock.Now().UTC()
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeStudentOnboardingTurn(input)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	requestHash, err := studentOnboardingTurnHash(normalized)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, err
	}
	normalized.RequestHash = requestHash
	result, replayed, err := useCase.Turns.ApplyOnboardingTurn(ctx, normalized, useCase.EffectsEnabled)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, err
	}
	result.Replayed = replayed
	return result, nil
}

type GetStudentOnboardingTurn struct {
	Turns repository.StudentOnboardingTurnRepository
}

func (useCase GetStudentOnboardingTurn) Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID, commandID string) (domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult, error) {
	studentID, commandID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID), strings.TrimSpace(commandID)
	if useCase.Turns == nil || !validStudentUUID(studentID) || !validStudentUUID(commandID) {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return useCase.Turns.GetOnboardingTurn(ctx, studentID, commandID)
}

type ProveStudentOnboardingTurnNoEffect struct {
	Turns repository.StudentOnboardingTurnRepository
	Clock OnboardingClock
}

func (useCase ProveStudentOnboardingTurnNoEffect) Handle(
	ctx context.Context,
	input domain.StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof,
) (domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult, error) {
	if useCase.Turns == nil || useCase.Clock == nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	input.OccurredAt = useCase.Clock.Now().UTC()
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeStudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof(input)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	requestHash, err := studentOnboardingTurnHash(normalized.Command)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, err
	}
	normalized.Command.RequestHash = requestHash
	result, replayed, err := useCase.Turns.ProveOnboardingTurnNoEffect(ctx, normalized)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, err
	}
	result.Replayed = replayed
	return result, nil
}

func studentOnboardingTurnHash(input domain.StudentOnboardingTurnCommand) (string, error) {
	type slot struct {
		SlotCode              string                             `json:"slot_code"`
		CodeValue             *string                            `json:"code_value,omitempty"`
		TextValue             *string                            `json:"text_value,omitempty"`
		StacksValue           *[]string                          `json:"stacks_value,omitempty"`
		IntegerValue          *int                               `json:"integer_value,omitempty"`
		Origin                domain.StudentOnboardingTurnOrigin `json:"origin"`
		ConfidenceBasisPoints *int                               `json:"confidence_basis_points,omitempty"`
		DefaultRuleCode       *string                            `json:"default_rule_code,omitempty"`
	}
	payload := struct {
		Schema                    string  `json:"schema"`
		StudentID                 string  `json:"student_id"`
		StudentCommandID          string  `json:"student_command_id"`
		DialogID                  string  `json:"dialog_id"`
		PersonalTeacherID         string  `json:"personal_teacher_id"`
		TeacherTurnSequence       int64   `json:"teacher_turn_sequence"`
		CanonicalStudentMessageID string  `json:"canonical_student_message_id"`
		ActionReceiptID           *string `json:"action_receipt_id,omitempty"`
		SourceEventID             string  `json:"source_event_id"`
		DialogCausationID         string  `json:"dialog_causation_id"`
		TeacherJobID              string  `json:"teacher_job_id"`
		AIExecutionID             *string `json:"ai_execution_id,omitempty"`
		CorrelationID             string  `json:"correlation_id"`
		CausationID               string  `json:"causation_id"`
		ExpectedDraftVersion      int64   `json:"expected_draft_version"`
		ExpectedProfileVersion    *int64  `json:"expected_profile_version,omitempty"`
		FinalizeCurrentV1         bool    `json:"finalize_current_v1"`
		Slots                     []slot  `json:"slots"`
	}{
		Schema: input.Schema, StudentID: input.StudentID, StudentCommandID: input.StudentCommandID,
		DialogID: input.DialogID, PersonalTeacherID: input.PersonalTeacherID, TeacherTurnSequence: input.TeacherTurnSequence,
		CanonicalStudentMessageID: input.CanonicalStudentMessageID, ActionReceiptID: input.ActionReceiptID,
		SourceEventID: input.SourceEventID, DialogCausationID: input.DialogCausationID, TeacherJobID: input.TeacherJobID, AIExecutionID: input.AIExecutionID,
		CorrelationID: input.CorrelationID, CausationID: input.CausationID,
		ExpectedDraftVersion: input.ExpectedDraftVersion, ExpectedProfileVersion: input.ExpectedProfileVersion,
		FinalizeCurrentV1: input.FinalizeCurrentV1,
	}
	for _, current := range input.Slots {
		payload.Slots = append(payload.Slots, slot(current))
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(payload)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	return hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]), nil
}
